# The PMD edits that "save enhanced model" (menu 263) writes: a toon
# texture name (menu 261) and the physics model (menu 262); the save also
# sets the model path that the PMM records. The English names (menu 259) are
# not here: README.md, "Not reached".
load model lips.pmd
toon 3 toonx.bmp

physics model open
dialog text 718 2.5
dialog select 704 3
dialog text 712 0.25
dialog click 727
dialog ok
save pmd edited.pmd
save pmm edited.pmm

physics model open
dialog text 718 9
dialog cancel
save pmd cancelled.pmd
